dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I've been friends with the two young masters of the family he serves for a long time. The younger of them, Xingqiu, is a warm-hearted and chivalrous soul for someone of his age. I was definitely right to put my faith in him.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Of course, I also have you and Xu to thank in this case... *sigh* If this sum hadn't come in this month, I'd have some trouble making ends meet before my next payday.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Either way, I can now start worrying about next month's expenditures.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Man, how much Mora does this guy owe...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Heh, well, old habits die hard, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: But to be honest, I haven't had the time to go to Yanshang Teahouse in a long while Not since I got assigned here, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: It's just that old debts still need paying, you know? I... guess I'll have to trouble all of you in the future as well.

choices.text: You should probably manage your finances better.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: *sigh* You're right. I suppose I just don't consider these things enough.

choices.text: You shouldn't waste the goodwill of your friends.
